chart_mapping.mapping: Use height, timestamp, tx_count, size, extras.pool.name, extras.totalFees. 15 recent records returned. BTC = sats / 1e8; MB = bytes / 1e6. Do not confuse totalFees and reward.
Backlog count/vbytes, fee tiers with sub-sat precision, projected block fee bands, and retarget progress/estimate. Display observation time and stale status.

Retrieve a contiguous height/hash-checked set of exactly 144 blocks (plus predecessor if computing all 144 intervals); aggregate tx_count, fees, size, weight, pool counts. Fullness = weight / 4000000; rank highest fees/fullest/biggest/busiest from actual blocks. Reward endpoint supplies only totals, not all individual blocks. Pagination source documented; this research fetched only the initial 15, not all 144.
chart_mapping.uncertainty: Define and label arithmetic versus weighted fee-rate average; original site formula is unverified. Header timestamps can move backward; do not silently claim a zero-second fastest block. Fee Pressure/Mining Pace category thresholds are not verified.

chart_mapping.mapping: share = pool.blockCount / response.blockCount * 100. Preserve unknown pool. Same provider window for numerator/denominator.
chart_mapping.uncertainty: Response has no per-pool reward sum; do not multiply counts by an average and present it as actual rewards. Need separately verified complete block/reward data if reward labels are required.

chart_mapping.source: /api/v1/mining/pools/24h and detailed blocks paged to the window boundary
chart_mapping.mapping: 24h block count and top miner available in pools result; last-hour count, fastest/slowest intervals, transactions and fullness require complete detailed window. Expected 24h count = 144; expected hourly = 6; production pace = measured24hCount/144*100.
chart_mapping.uncertainty: Last 144 blocks is not a 24h window (verified 24h count was 156). Define header-timestamp based windows honestly; firstSeen was null on fetched detailed blocks.

chart_mapping.mapping: Plot hashrates[].avgHashrate against timestamp and difficulty[].difficulty against time using separate units/axes. Render currentHashrate/currentDifficulty. Hashrate / 1e18 => EH/s, / 1e21 => ZH/s. Difficulty / 1e12 => T.

cadence_and_access.observed: All fetched Mempool endpoints returned Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *. Mining pool, reward and hashrate results returned max-age=120. Mempool REST returned max-age=1. Blocks, fees, projected blocks, and difficulty returned no-cache plus public. Cache headers are not an allowed polling rate.
cadence_and_access.recommended_not_provider_contract: Only active sphere scene starts exclusive feeds; stop/abort on leave and while hidden. Cache/dedupe identical data across room selections. At most one in-flight request per resource. New blocks invalidate recent-block/144/production views; a visible-only 30-60s fallback can refresh small live summaries. Do not refetch unchanged historical pages. Mining histories can use a several-minute cadence respecting cache age. Honor Retry-After and back off on 429; preserve last successful data as stale.
cadence_and_access.rate_terms: Mempool official REST docs state rate limits apply, exceeding them yields HTTP 429, repeated excess may lead to a ban, enterprise sponsorship offers higher limits. No fixed numeric allowance was verified. No TimechainIndex rate limit or redistribution terms were found in fetched public documentation.

timechainindex_api.sample_status: The following examples are from published docs, NOT authenticated live payloads.
notes: Never ship an API key in the static client; a keyed integration requires an explicitly configured server secret/proxy.
These documented aggregate endpoints do not establish a last-144-block or one-week response contract.
Current OBL timechain-data.js separately uses six public /OogaBooga/ endpoints for existing distribution/holdings boards; no additional /OogaBooga/ block-chart endpoint has been verified.

implementation_cautions: Do not load third-party chart scripts or embed the source website; draw native OBL charts under current CSP.
Treat malformed/missing fields as unavailable; never coerce them to zero or label stale data LIVE.
Snapshots can race a new block/reorg: validate contiguous heights and parent hashes, deduplicate and repair bounded history before aggregating.
Global Bitcoin data may be shared/cached; room membership and voice must remain separately isolated.
This research establishes API feasibility, not a guarantee that all named charts reproduce TimechainIndex formulas exactly.
